blocks_element.repere: Bouton · For whom is FLO™ brush not recommended?
blocks_element.text: For whom is FLO™ brush not recommended?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The use of the scalp brush is not recomm
blocks_element.text:
The use of the scalp brush is not recommended if you belong to one of these categories:

- Pregnant individuals.
- Those with cognitive disorders, sensitivity to touch, or perception problems of any kind.
- Individuals with head injuries, scabbing, cracking, swelling, or severe scalp conditions (e.g. acute forms of dermatitis with significant scabs and other severe forms of eczema or skin problems)
- Patients affected by hypertension, if you suffer from seizures, heart problems, or have a pacemaker.
- If you have acute or malignant tumors, bleeding diseases, hemophilia, or similar medical conditions.
- Individuals with allergies that may be related to comb teeth materials: copper, steel, and electroplating.

Prioritize your well-being.
In case of any other doubts or before beginning a new hair care journey consult your doctor or healthcare provider, especially if you have health concerns.

With consistent daily use, most users first notice improvements at the scalp level.

Within the first few weeks, the scalp environment typically becomes more balanced, with reduced dryness, flakes, and irritation.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Who is FLO™ Brush for?
blocks_element.text: Who is FLO™ Brush for?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our hair growth brush is suitable for an
blocks_element.text:
Our hair growth brush is suitable for any hair type and scalp condition and for anyone looking for:

Shinier, healthier hair: Our red light therapy brush can help nourish and revitalize your hair for a radiant, healthy appearance.

Scalp health: Address common concerns like irritation, dandruff, flaking, dry scalp, and oiliness, promoting a balanced scalp environment for hair growth and thicker hair shafts. The technologies of our scalp brush are safe to use and designed to heal the skin soothing itchy scalp and conditions like dermatitis and similar. *If you suffer from severe scalp conditions. please contact your doctor first.

Fighting hair loss: Our hair growth stimulator is suitable for anyone struggling with hair loss and thinning hair, whether due to aging, stress, or hereditary conditions. It stimulates and strengthens hair follicles, boosts nutrient delivery, and creates the perfect environment for hair growth. It has been shown that red light, microcurrents, and even scalp massage can be a valuable support for those struggling with androgenetic alopecia (AGA), helping to slow down hair loss and promote hair growth.
Why does It work?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · FLO™ works by targeting the key scalp co
blocks_element.text:
FLO™ works by targeting the key scalp conditions that influence hair health and growth.

Red light therapy has been widely studied for its ability to support cellular activity and improve blood circulation in the scalp, helping create an environment where hair follicles can function more efficiently.

Microcurrent stimulation helps reduce scalp tension and support overall scalp health, while thermotherapy and vibrating massage improve blood flow, skin permeability, and relaxation.

This matters because a tense, poorly perfused scalp can limit hair growth, even when effective treatments are applied.

By improving circulation, stimulating the follicles, and enhancing scalp receptivity, FLO™ helps create the ideal conditions for healthier, stronger hair over time.

When used together with topical treatments, these effects are amplified, as the scalp becomes more receptive and better able to absorb active ingredients.
How to use it ?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Fill the pod with your chosen serum or t
blocks_element.text:
Fill the pod with your chosen serum or topical treatment, turn on the device, gently massage your scalp in the way you prefer, and there you go!
Make sure you touch the scalp with the brush, slowly following the shape of the head, focusing more on the areas of the scalp you want to revitalize, if there are any. The technologies work through the little teeth (besides red light), and as long as they touch the scalp, the device will work wonders, revitalizing the skin and hair follicles. After 5 minutes, the device turns off automatically.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Does Red Light Therapy work?
blocks_element.text: Does Red Light Therapy work?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In 1903 N.Finsen won a Nobel using Red L
blocks_element.text: In 1903 N.Finsen won a Nobel using Red Light (LLLT) to treat cutaneous tuberculosis and other skin conditions. In the ‘80s NASA used Red Light to grow plants in space. Countless studies support Red Light Therapy. In fact, in 2018, 22 studies comparing LLLT to other common drug treatments such as Minoxidil were examined. This meta-analysis concluded that red light therapy was a superior treatment. Most importantly, while many of the drugs had negative side effects, red light therapy was found to have none.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Its anti-inflammatory effect helps norma
blocks_element.text: Its anti-inflammatory effect helps normalize the functioning of sebaceous glands to moisturize the scalp and kill bacteria. More regulated sebum production makes the dry scalp less dry and the oily scalp less oily. In 2021, a study revealed that microcurrent stimulates cell reproduction and triggers regrowth in resting follicles.

blocks_element.text: Scalp massage loosens muscle tension and restores proper blood circulation which are key factors in hair loss. It seems that even the greatest emperor in history was already aware of it. It is said that Julius Caesar used to have his head massaged to combat baldness.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · What does Thermo Therapy do?
blocks_element.text: What does Thermo Therapy do?

blocks_element.text: How long does it take for hair to grow back?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Hair grows at an average rate of about 1
blocks_element.text:
Hair grows at an average rate of about 1 to 1.5 centimeters per month. However, this varies depending on factors like age, genetics, and overall health. It's important to note that once a hair follicle is dead, it cannot produce new hair. That’s why acting fast with tools like the FLO™ red light therapy brush is essential to help support active follicles, accelerating the growth cycle and promoting faster, healthier growth.

With consistent use, FLO™ users often notice new hair growth in as little as 3 months, while for more noticeable improvements, it can take up to 6 months of consistent use.
